description: We are the SPACE GAMERS, a Class 6 and 7 team passionate about space and gaming! Our mission is to make learning about space fun and interactive through a Space Gaming App. We combine NASA's real space data with exciting gameplay, so kids can explore planets, launch rockets, and learn about the universe while playing. We are young, creative, and ready to build a game that is educational, fun, and out of this world!
summary:
130 million pieces of space debris orbit Earth at 28,000 km/h - even a 1cm paint chip can destroy the ISS. With over 36,500 tracked objects as per NASA ODPO 2024 report and ESA 2023 estimate, LEO is becoming unusable. Kessler Syndrome means one collision creates more debris in a chain reaction that can lock us out of space.

Space Debris Cleaner by Team Space Gamers gamifies this crisis. We built a fast-paced cleaner game where players protect ISS using NASA ODPO-inspired mechanics. The game teaches Kessler Syndrome, orbital zones LEO MEO GEO, and real cleanup tech.

Players learn why clean orbit matters: Protect 7 astronauts, save GPS/weather/internet satellites, prevent chain-reaction collisions, and secure future space travel. Our motto: CLEAN SPACE, SAFE FUTURE. Fun to play, scientifically grounded, built for students.
details:
Challenge Name: Create a Game that Raises Awareness of Space Debris - NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

Our project is an educational browser game - SPACE DEBRIS CLEANER - that simulates the critical problem of orbital debris.
Players become an orbital cleaner with 3 real-world inspired tools (Magnetic Net 35px, Laser Zap, Robotic Arm Shockwave 120px) to protect ISS.

Game Flow:
Level 1 LEO 400km (0-150 pts, 1.0x speed, 400ms) to Level 2 MEO 800km (151-400 pts, 1.35x speed, 280ms, Solar Storm and Ice Split hazards) to Level 3 GEO 36,000km (401+ pts endless, 1.8x speed, 180ms, Explosive Satellites 30% damage and Dust Clouds).
Scoring: Micro 1pt, Medium 5pt, Large 10pt, Explosive 25pt. Level up bonus +25% health repair, +35% velocity scaling.
Built with HTML5 Canvas + Vanilla JavaScript, pure JS, no external libraries, runs in any browser, no install needed. Mission: Gamify, Educate, Protect.
